text: You could be friends with a vampire and never notice. Start with the small things.
Sign one. They always offer to take the group photo.
Sign two. At your door, they wait until you say come in. Every single time.
Sign three. The garlic bread arrives. They suddenly need the loo.
Sign four. They tidy the sugar sachets. Then they count them. Twice.
Sign five. Cold hands. Bad circulation, they say. For eleven years.
Sign six. You've never been to their place. Not once.
And sign seven. They're the one who sent you this video.
